{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commerce is the lifeblood of the economy, and the transportation infrastructure is its circulatory system.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Without safe and efficient transport, the economy withers away.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Maintaining transportation infrastructure has historically been, in part, a federal responsibility.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans have historically been the party of builders.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Eisenhower established the Interstate Highway System.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 1998 Transportation Equity Act for the Twenty-First Century and the Aviation Investment and Reform Act represent an unprecedented federal investment in roads, bridges, transit systems, airports and air traffic control systems.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 1998 Transportation Equity Act for the Twenty-First Century and the Aviation Investment and Reform Act were enacted without additional taxes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 1998 Transportation Equity Act for the Twenty-First Century and the Aviation Investment and Reform Act unlock transportation trust funds to invest dollars motorists and the traveling public have already paid.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Transportation trust funds had been subject to years of abuse under Democrat-controlled Congresses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Statutory dedication of funds is now in place for building and maintaining the transportation system for which citizens pay.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The same budgetary protections should be extended to other transportation trust funds.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
